metadata.name: MerchantRateTable
metadata.description: To get details of Merchant Rate Table.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: UpdateFlag
request_fields.description: Indicates whether request is an insert request or update request 1: for Update request 0: for Insert request

request_fields.name: InstitutionId
request_fields.description: Unique identification number for Institution. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:Fixed value needs to pass which is provided by Corecard.

request_fields.name: MRTID
request_fields.description: Merchant rate table ID is mendatory when request is an update request Valid Values:0-9,A-Z Format: XXX Example: 561 Condition: Mandatory when its an update request Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: MerchantRateTable
request_fields.description: This tag refers  to the Rate table of that plan. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:6 Months No Interest if Paid in Full Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: MerchantRateParentName
request_fields.description: It is used to provide Parent to inherit Merchant Rate Table Valid Values:0-9, A-Z Format: XXXX Example: MRT1 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: FeeType
request_fields.description: Type of Fee included - 0: Discount 1: Participation Valid Values:0,1 Format:X Example:0,1

request_fields.name: DiscountFeeTiming
request_fields.description: Frequency of Discount Fee- 0: Daily 1: Weekly 2: Cycle 3: Per Transaction Valid Values:0,1,2,3 Format: X Example: 0,1,2,3

request_fields.name: FeeCalculationBasis
request_fields.description: On what basis the fee will calculated as - 0: Count 1: Amount 2: Both Valid Values:0,1,2 Format: X Example: 0,1,2

request_fields.name: VolumeType
request_fields.description: Volume Type 0: Daily 1: Weekly Valid Values:0,1 Format: X Example: 0,1

request_fields.name: FeeCalculation
request_fields.description: Fee Calculation 0: Percent of volume amount Valid Values:0 Format: X Example: 0 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: AmountPerVolume
request_fields.description: Amount Per Volume Valid Values:0-9 Format: XX.XX Example: 245.22

request_fields.name: AmountPerTransaction
request_fields.description: Amount per transaction. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XX.XX Example: 245.22

request_fields.name: TransactionCode
request_fields.description: Transaction Code for the posting of Single Transaction. Valid Values: 427248 = Principal Adjustment Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: MRTDetailList
request_fields.description: MRTDetailList

request_fields.name: FICOScore
request_fields.description: Fico score value range Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX Example:620

request_fields.name: FixedRate5

request_fields.name: TierLimitIndicator
request_fields.description: It indicates the Tier Limit as follows 0: Balances in each limit 1: Highest limit where balance falls Valid Values:0,1 Format: X Example: 0,1 Allowable Values: 19
